description: B30 at the battle start. Leads: Abomasnow (Snow Warning, raw Speed 85) + Excadrill against Pelipper (Drizzle, raw 85, Choice Scarf: action Speed 127) + Ribombee. The start's `switchIn` calls queue every `runSwitch` through `insertChoice` (`updateSpeed()`), so Drizzle runs before Snow Warning and the battle starts in snow with probability 1 (raw Speeds would tie). The turn: everyone protects.
